scenes.title: Lights, Camera, Action
scenes.summary: In a flash-forward studio interview and film set in Tokyo, Kaoru Kuroki speaks about living naturally and love while Toru Muranishi prepares to roll the camera and calls action.

scenes.title: Opening Title Sequence
scenes.summary: Opening music and a brief transition carry the story back to Sapporo, Hokkaido in 1980.

scenes.title: Trouble at the Arcade Cafe
scenes.summary: Skipping work at a Sapporo coffeehouse arcade, Muranishi tells rowdy schoolboys to take their noisy argument over a game high score outside.

scenes.title: Zero Contracts Again
scenes.summary: At Bianca International, the section chief scolds Muranishi for having zero sales contracts again and warns he will be fired unless he learns from top salesman Ono.

scenes.title: Passing Ono's Test
scenes.summary: Muranishi asks Ono to teach him sales; Ono quizzes him on Alfred Hitchcock and Japanese pop music until they sing together and Ono agrees to mentor him starting tomorrow.
scenes.location: Bianca International office and Sapporo street

scenes.title: No Humming at Breakfast
scenes.summary: At breakfast, Muranishi's mother Kozue scolds him for humming cheerfully during a recession, and Muranishi boasts that he is teaming up with the company's top salesman.

scenes.title: Arcade Coins in His Pocket
scenes.summary: As Muranishi leaves for work claiming he has overtime, his son Daisuke asks him to come home early while daughter Mayumi catches arcade coins spilling from his pocket.

scenes.title: A Movie During Work Hours
scenes.summary: Instead of making sales calls, Ono takes Muranishi to a cinema matinee and hands him a copy of Jonathan Livingston Seagull to read about freedom.

scenes.title: Planes Over Fukushima
scenes.summary: Reading the book triggers a brief childhood memory of young Toru and his father Konosuke watching airplanes fly across the sky.

scenes.title: Do You Like English?
scenes.summary: Muranishi rings doorbells with an awkward smile asking residents if they like English, gets rejected at every door, and hears Ono's blunt critique.

scenes.title: The Secret of Sales Talk
scenes.summary: Ono praises Muranishi for supporting four family members alone, then reveals that sincere praise and simple English words are the true secret to winning over customers.

scenes.title: At Nakai's Mansion
scenes.summary: Trying Ono's advice at an imposing residence, Muranishi flatters Mrs. Nakai about a special English encyclopedia set until her intimidating husband Nakai invites him inside.
scenes.location: Nakai mansion gate and tatami room

scenes.title: Love, Good, and Hello
scenes.summary: Inside the mansion, a terrified Muranishi apologizes profusely, praises Nakai's Kintaro design as one of a kind, and pitches three short English words before an accidental slip.

scenes.title: An English Master Tomorrow
scenes.summary: Recovering quickly, Muranishi gets Nakai enthusiastically shouting 'Good!', 'Hello!', and 'Love!', and closes his very first encyclopedia sale with Mrs. Nakai.

scenes.title: One Hundred Yen a Day
scenes.summary: Ono congratulates Muranishi on surviving Nakai's house, and Muranishi hones his own style by reframing three thousand yen a month as just one hundred yen a day.
scenes.location: Sapporo street and customer living room

scenes.title: Last Chance, Just Now
scenes.summary: Arriving late to an appointment, Muranishi apologizes for keeping the client waiting too long, declares today their last chance to decide, and closes the sale on the spot.

scenes.title: Number One Salesman
scenes.summary: Crowned Bianca International's number-one monthly salesman, Muranishi celebrates at home and promises toys for the children and a bigger house for the family.
scenes.location: Bianca International office and Muranishi home

scenes.title: Late Night at Home
scenes.summary: Later that night in their bedroom, Sachiko tells Muranishi she is glad his work is finally going well and has high hopes for him.

scenes.title: The Empty Office Safe
scenes.summary: Muranishi arrives at Bianca International to find police cars outside and learns from his section chief that Ono has vanished with all the company's sales revenue from the safe.

scenes.title: Quiet Stop at a Diner
scenes.summary: Stunned by the collapse of his company, Muranishi sits silently in a neighborhood diner listening to a traffic announcement before walking out without ordering.

scenes.title: Returning Home Early
scenes.summary: Muranishi comes home in the middle of the day and hears voices upstairs before climbing the stairs.

scenes.title: Sachiko Leaves Home
scenes.summary: After a bitter confrontation at home, Sachiko packs up and walks out of the house taking Mayumi and young Daisuke with her.

scenes.title: Flashback Transition
scenes.summary: Alone in the empty house, Muranishi drifts into a painful memory of his parents in post-war Fukushima.

scenes.title: Without Money, No Freedom
scenes.summary: In a childhood flashback, Kozue and Konosuke argue bitterly over money meant to buy rice for Toru, and Konosuke mutters that without money a person can never be free.

scenes.title: Meeting Toshi at the Bar
scenes.summary: At a noisy Susukino snack bar, Toshi argues with an angry buyer until Mama-san warns him not to cause trouble, then introduces himself to Muranishi over a drink.

scenes.title: Two Sides of Desire
scenes.summary: Over drinks, Toshi shows Muranishi cassette tapes recorded in Susukino and argues that everyone has a public face and a hidden side, offering to show him that hidden world.

scenes.title: Inside the Susukino Building
scenes.summary: Toshi brings Muranishi into a Susukino building back room to witness how he records his tapes.

scenes.title: Sixty Thousand Yen
scenes.summary: Taking Toshi's tapes to a specialty shop owner, Muranishi uses polished sales flattery to sell twenty tapes for sixty thousand yen and proposes teaming up to sell sixty a day.

scenes.title: No Turning Back
scenes.summary: Seeing sealed vinyl-wrapped magazines in a shop window and learning they sell over a million copies a month, Muranishi resolves not to turn back and heads into Showtime.

scenes.title: End Credits
scenes.summary: Closing theme music plays over the end credits of Episode 1.
